people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Truly help from the hills, the tumult on the mountains, is in vain. Truly the salvation of Israel is in Yahweh our God.
translations.bsb: Surely deception comes from the hills, and commotion from the mountains. Surely the salvation of Israel is in the LORD our God.
translations.kjv: Truly in vain is salvation hoped for from the hills, and from the multitude of mountains: truly in the LORD our God is the salvation of Israel.
translations.asv: Truly in vain is the help that is looked for from the hills, the tumult on the mountains: truly in Jehovah our God is the salvation of Israel.
